description: Execute pre-built native mobile test suites (Espresso for Android, XCUITest for iOS) by direct upload to BrowserStack. ONLY for compiled .apk/.ipa test files. This is NOT for SDK integration or Appium tests. For Appium-based testing with SDK setup, use 'setupBrowserStackAppAutomateTests' instead.

appPath.description:
Path to your application file:
If in development IDE directory:
• For Android: 'gradle assembleDebug'
• For iOS:
  xcodebuild clean -scheme YOUR_SCHEME && \
  xcodebuild archive -scheme YOUR_SCHEME -configuration Release -archivePath build/app.xcarchive && \
  xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath build/app.xcarchive -exportPath build/ipa -exportOptionsPlist exportOptions.plist

If in other directory, provide existing app path.
The resolved file must be located inside the directory set in MCP_UPLOAD_BASE_DIR.

detectedAutomationFramework.description: The automation framework used in the project, such as 'espresso' (Android) or 'xcuitest' (iOS).

devices.description: Tuples describing target mobile devices. Add device only when user asks explicitly for it. Defaults to [] . Example: [['android', 'Samsung Galaxy S24', '14'], ['ios', 'iPhone 15', '17']]

deviceName.description: Device name, e.g. 'Samsung Galaxy S24', 'Google Pixel 8', 'iPhone 15', 'iPhone 14 Pro'

project.description: Project name for organizing test runs on BrowserStack.

testSuitePath.description:
Path to your test suite file:
If in development IDE directory:
• For Android: 'gradle assembleAndroidTest'
• For iOS:
  xcodebuild test-without-building -scheme YOUR_SCHEME -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' && \
  cd ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/*/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/ && \
  zip -r Tests.zip *.xctestrun *-Runner.app

If in other directory, provide existing test file path.
The resolved file must be located inside the directory set in MCP_UPLOAD_BASE_DIR.

name: runAppTestsOnBrowserStack
